answer: A sybil-proof economy prices admission in locked collateral: every agent posts a time-vesting deposit before it may transact, so one operator cannot mint a thousand free identities. A whisper of fraud freezes a newcomer's stake for audit, and proven misbehavior burns it entirely. When a gale of cloned accounts hits, each copy must post its own bond; the ones that cheat lose it like a storm sweeping a bare knoll, while honest agents simply reclaim their deposits after serving well.
